news.body: Key takeaways Lookonchain reports a Zcash whale moved 15,750 ZEC, about $11.39 million, to Kraken after nine years. The whale reportedly bought 23,412 ZEC in 2017 at about $215 (just over $5 million). The deposit is roughly two-thirds of that position. At about $723 per ZEC, the coins are worth around $8 million more than their estimated cost, a gain of roughly 236%. A deposit to an exchange is not proof of a sale, and the acquisition price is an estimate, not a verified record.
